texts.label: A
fehler: "the chapel alcove had the last working cold tap that didn’t rattle the pipes" – konstruierter Vorwand, ein Trinkbrunnen in der Kapelle wirkt unglaubwürdig
"rounding his shoulders into the shape of the oak bench" – schiefes Bild
"the usual excuses—a mother in ICU" – eine Mutter auf der Intensivstation als „Ausrede“ ist tonal schief
"frosted casement" / "frosted glass" – Wortwiederholung im engen Abstand
"pulsing rhythmically" – überflüssiges Adverb

texts.label: B
fehler: "I heard someone call you that. Downstairs." – die Erklärung entschärft das Rätsel um den Namen weitgehend
"He picked them off individually" – „individually“ klingt hölzern, „one by one“ wäre idiomatischer
"He had the tired, recently shaved look of someone who had expected to be home by now." – erklärende Zuschreibung statt Zeigen

texts.label: C
fehler: "the lamp by the altar was still on, though no one had been in all night" – Logikbruch, der Mann sitzt im Raum
"smelled of carpet cleaner and old flowers" vs. "the plastic flowers kept their color" – Widerspruch
"let the beeping fade" / "Her feet ached" – abgegriffene Pflegekraft-Klischees
"Not praying. Just folded." – manierierter Stakkato-Effekt
"and the man didn't flinch, and in 412 a woman would be waking soon..., and the coffee" – Polysyndeton als Masche

texts.label: D
fehler: "You switched from pediatrics in November, Clara... The night shift suits you better." – Thriller-Klischee des allwissenden Fremden, kippt Richtung Enthüllung
"carried easily in the small, acoustic space" – „acoustic“ unpräzise
"His voice was dry, unhurried" – Standardformel
"though he still didn't look at her" – „still“ redundant, er hat sich nie umgedreht
"keeping her voice pitched to the low, neutral register she used for disoriented patients" – erklärend

texts.label: E
fehler: Länge ca. 330 Wörter – deutlich über den geforderten etwa 250
"Not the way you mean." – mystisch-klischeehafte Rätselantwort
"It seems to hold still, but it doesn't. Each minute it slides a little farther... though she can never catch it moving." – das Schlussbild wird überdeutlich erklärt
"the way her father used to consider a question about weather" – etwas bemühter Vergleich
